notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.8 Mixer / Arranger — gain & mute/solo correctness - Fixed arranger track gain being applied twice, so faders no longer over- or under-shoot their set level — there's now a single track gain stage. - Mute and Solo now act as one gate that reaches both the arranger and step-sequencer engines, so a muted/soloed track behaves consistently everywhere. - Freeze now captures the track's audio content, not the fader position — freezing a track no longer bakes in a doubled gain.
